title: Report matrix: a cell's drill-through dialog shows only the 「标题」 column, not the status, priority and hours its filter chips name
body:
qa#1 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpxQpmErd1ixfkgbYh

Found by the milestone acceptance of #36255 (record #37022) on main `305fe60e`.

**Reproduction:** open `/report/showcase_status_priority_matrix`, then hover and click `[data-testid=dataset-drill-cell]` nth(2) (待办 / 中).

- **Expected:** default columns 标题, 状态, 优先级, 预计工时, matching the dialog's chips.
- **Actual:** `th` is `["标题"]`. The request is `GET /api/v1/data/showcase_task?top=50&select=id,title,done&filter=["and",["estimate_hours","isnotnull",null],["status","=","todo"],["priority","=","medium"]]`.
- **Contrast:**
  - a summary report row gives 标题, 状态, 预计工时;
  - a dashboard pivot cell gives 标题, 状态, 优先级.
  The matrix drill builds its `select` without the dimensions and measure field it filters on.

QA-source: #37022 · dashboards.drill-through-range · observed beside the clauses
